issues.claim: 30 секунд сужают окно ... По умолчанию допуск расхождения часов составляет 5 минут.
issues.problem: The RU text uses the numeral '30', while EN spells it out as 'Thirty seconds'. This is the cause of the mechanical parity failure ('30' vs none). The facts are identical.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the two locales consistent. For example, write 'The default clock skew is 5 minutes. A 30-second skew narrows...' in EN, or spell the number out in RU as 'тридцать секунд'.

issues.claim: Defaults of ValidateAudience, ValidateLifetime and ClockSkew (5 minutes) are cited to the TokenValidationParameters page.
issues.problem: The fetched excerpt shows only RequireSignedTokens defaulting to true. The defaults for ValidateAudience, ValidateLifetime and ClockSkew are not visible in it. They are correct from my own knowledge (all true; DefaultClockSkew is 300 s), and the RFC 8725 section 3.9 audience claim is correct too.
issues.suggestedFix: No change needed. Optionally confirm on the live page before setting meta.verified.

issues.claim: Reuse of an old one signals theft, and the server revokes the whole chain.
issues.problem: RFC 9700 §4.14.2 says the server will revoke the active refresh token when a reused one is detected. 'Whole chain' (the whole token family or grant) is common practice but a bit stronger than the RFC wording, and the excerpt does not show this section.
issues.suggestedFix: Soften to 'and the server revokes the active refresh token (typically the whole token family)'. Apply the same change in RU: 'и сервер отзывает активный refresh token (обычно всё семейство токенов)'.

issues.claim: Короткие access token переносят состояние... «догорает» сам
issues.problem: 'догорает' is colloquial in a reference text. The meaning is unaffected.
issues.suggestedFix: Use 'истекает сам' in place of '«догорает» сам'.
